sql_query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

question_template: 查询销售额最高的商品
sql_query: SELECT product_name, SUM(price * quantity) as total_sales FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
description: 查询销售额最高的前10个商品
